f.id, f.layer_id, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_ForcePolygonCCW(f.geom), 15, 0) AS geometry_json, f.properties::text AS properties_json, f.source_feature_id::text AS source_feature_id, f.source_feature_index, f.version, f.create_time, f.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ocean_gis.gis_file_meta WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocean_gis.gis_vector_import_task (id, task_no, request_id, source_file_id, data_set_id, source_storage_key, source_sha256, source_size_bytes, source_metadata_version, layer_name, split_mode, operator_id) VALUES (#{t.id}, #{t.taskNo}, #{t.requestId}, #{t.sourceFileId}, #{t.dataSetId}, #{t.sourceStorageKey}, #{t.sourceSha256}, #{t.sourceSizeBytes}, #{t.sourceMetadataVersion}, #{t.layerName}, #{t.splitMode}, #{t.operatorId})

INSERT INTO ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer (id, import_task_id, data_set_id, source_file_id, layer_key, layer_name) VALUES (#{l.id}, #{l.importTaskId}, #{l.dataSetId}, #{l.sourceFileId}, #{l.layerKey}, #{l.layerName})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_import_task WHERE ORDER BY create_time, id LIMIT #{limit}

UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_import_task SET task_status = 'RUNNING', version = version + 1, start_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, lease_expires_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '15 minutes', processed_feature_count = 0, error_message = NULL, error_feature_index = NULL, finish_time = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND RETURNING *
SELECT * FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_import_task WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND task_status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_import_task SET lease_expires_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '15 minutes', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND task_status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_import_task SET processed_feature_count = #{count}, lease_expires_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '15 minutes', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND task_status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_import_task SET task_status = #{status}, processed_feature_count = #{count}, lease_expires_at = NULL, error_feature_index = #{errorIndex}, error_message = #{error}, finish_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND task_status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_import_task SET task_status = 'QUEUED', version = version + 1, error_message = NULL, error_feature_index = NULL, finish_time = NULL, start_time = NULL, processed_feature_count = 0, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status = 'FAILED'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l WHERE l.import_task_id = #{taskId} AND l.deleted = 0 ORDER BY l.id
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer SET layer_status = 'IMPORTING', feature_count = 0, geographic_extent = NULL, geometry_types = '[]'::jsonb, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE import_task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature WHERE layer_id IN (SELECT id FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer WHERE import_task_id = #{taskId})
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer SET layer_status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE import_task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id = l.data_set_id AND ds.deleted = 0 WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.data_set_id = #{dataSetId} ORDER BY l.id DESC
SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id = l.data_set_id AND ds.deleted = 0 WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0
SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id = l.data_set_id AND ds.deleted = 0 WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE OF l
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l SET feature_count = s.total, geographic_extent = CASE WHEN s.total = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ST_SetSRID(s.bounds::geometry,4326) END, geometry_types = COALESCE(s.types, '[]'::jsonb), data_version = l.data_version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM (SELECT count(*) AS total, ST_Extent(geom) AS bounds, jsonb_agg(DISTINCT GeometryType(geom) ORDER BY GeometryType(geom)) AS types FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature WHERE layer_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0) s WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0
UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer SET deleted = 1, source_file_id = NULL, data_version = data_version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature (id, layer_id, geom, properties, source_feature_id, source_feature_index) VALUES
(#{f.id}, #{f.layerId}, ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(#{f.geometryJson}), CAST(#{f.propertiesJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{f.sourceFeatureId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{f.sourceFeatureIndex,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature f WHERE f.layer_id = #{layerId} AND f.id = #{id} AND f.deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature SET geom = ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(#{f.geometryJson}), properties = CAST(#{f.propertiesJson} AS jsonb), version = version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE layer_id = #{f.layerId} AND id = #{f.id} AND version = #{expected} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature SET deleted = 1, version = version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE layer_id = #{layerId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{expected} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer WHERE source_file_id = #{fileId} AND deleted = 0) + (SELECT count(*) FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_import_task WHERE source_file_id = #{fileId} AND task_status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING'))
